subject: English
question_text: The graph below shows the death rate of people in
stimulus: Bangladesh from 2010-2012. Describe the chart in 150 words. You should highlight and summarize the information given in the chart. 10
guide_solution: Graph & charts The pie chart shows the time allocation of students daily activities. From this pie chart it is seen that students have to maintain the time allocation for their daily necessary activities. They spend 10% time for homework, and they also need entertainment for which they spend 15% time. For playing they spend 19% time. For men's they spend 6% time. They go to school everyday and stay there for which they spend 25% time in school. They also spend 25% time for sleep. In this way, in this chart we see the time allocation of the students daily activities. On the whole, the pie chart represents the time allocation of students everyday activities.
source: SSC English 1st Paper Test Paper 106 — Habiganj Govt. High School
